name: Java Snippet Validation

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'scripts/extract-javadoc-java-snippets.sh'
      - 'scripts/java-snippet-to-playground-uri.sh'
      - '.github/workflows/java-snippet-validation.yml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'scripts/extract-javadoc-java-snippets.sh'
      - 'scripts/java-snippet-to-playground-uri.sh'
      - '.github/workflows/java-snippet-validation.yml'

jobs:
  validate-snippets:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up JDK
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Validate script syntax
        run: |
          bash -n scripts/extract-javadoc-java-snippets.sh
          bash -n scripts/java-snippet-to-playground-uri.sh

      - name: Extract JavaDoc snippets
        run: |
          chmod +x scripts/extract-javadoc-java-snippets.sh
          ./scripts/extract-javadoc-java-snippets.sh CodenameOne/src > snippets.jsonl
          echo "Extracted $(wc -l < snippets.jsonl) snippets"

      - name: Validate snippets
        run: |
          chmod +x scripts/java-snippet-to-playground-uri.sh
          # Process each snippet and validate
          while IFS= read -r line; do
            # Extract code field from JSONL record
            code=$(echo "$line" | jq -r '.code')
            if [ -n "$code" ] && [ "$code" != "null" ]; then
              # Validate snippet using the playground URI script
              # The script caches compilation via stamp file
              ./scripts/java-snippet-to-playground-uri.sh <<< "$code" || true
            fi
          done < snippets.jsonl
